items.html: When the third of Tifferet had not yet died, the descent and falling of the posterior of Aba and Ima had not yet been fully completed. So when these kings entered their vessels, they were revealed in a great light. But after the upper third of Tifferet died, at which point the posterior of Aba and Ima fell there, then, when the remaining lights came out to enter their vessels, they were clothed in these posterior that had fallen and remained in Atzilut, as above, and the last kings came out clothed in the posterior of Aba and Ima. This remained with them always, until all the selections finish coming out, until the End of Days, may it come speedily. This is the secret of the raising of MAN, whereby ZON raise MAN to Aba and Ima, and it stems from the secret of these posterior of Aba and Ima that descended there, down into Atzilut itself, as above, which they took.
